answer_1.quote: For an autonomous agent for EDA flow automation, users can provide the EDA task in natural language, and the agent will generate executable scripts to complete the EDA task via an LLM.
answer_1.outputs: Python scripts for EDA flow automation

answer_2.quote: ChatEDA-bench and iEDA-bench use the accuracy of the generated EDA script as the evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: we ask the decision-making agent to analyze and judge whether the generated EDA scripts can solve the EDA task.
methods: multiple choice selection with yes/no judgment
